text: The cooling fan bearing is worn. Its uneven rotation produces a low humming sound in the empty turbine hall.
The relay clock loses power at 02:13 each night. Its backup capacitor discharges and restarts the maintenance chime.
A recorded three-note maintenance chime played from the corridor speaker although nobody was on shift. The automatic relay reboot triggered the recording.
Rainwater entered through a cracked roof seal. Moisture shorted the corridor lighting circuit, making the lamps flicker.
Fresh boot prints near the locked entrance belong to the inspection team. Two technicians visited to check the roof damage.
The pressure gauge is stuck at forty kilopascals. A blocked sensing tube prevents the needle from returning to zero.
Replacing the backup capacitor stopped the nightly relay reset. No further unprompted chimes were logged during the following three nights.
The archive has no occupancy records for the years before 1987. Earlier personnel files were never transferred to this cabinet.
